services.desc: We offer three beautiful locations for weddings, receptions and commitment ceremonies. Start planning your special day at Agnes Scott now! Widely recognized for its unique beauty, our campus is just six miles east of Atlanta in trendy-but-quaint Decatur. Listed on the National Register of Historic Places, the college's 100-acre wooded grounds house century-old Gothic and Victorian architecture. It's the perfect destination for corporate events and meetings, non-profit fundraisers, performances, summer camps and more! Agnes Scott hosts movie projects each year and welcomes your location scouts for a campus tour. Film directors and crews appreciate our convenient location right outside

blurb: The Bradley Observatory (84 17 38.98 W, 33 45 54.84 N) is an astronomical teaching and research facility located on the campus of Agnes Scott College in Decatur, Georgia. The observatory, named in honor of William C. and Sarah Hall Bradley, welcomes guests with an artful plaza that represents our solar system and galaxy. This plaza provides a space for astronomical viewing with small telescopes.
